Montaigne at his best

"It is a rare life that remains orderly even in private. Everyone can play his part in the farce, and act an honest role on the stage. But to be disciplined within, in one's own breast, where all is permissible and all is concealed - that is the point!" https://t.co/NlKAP45mEI
